changes: The Assistant finds Claude Code that came with the Claude app, whatever folder it uses, or from its open Code session.
More places are searched: WinGet, Scoop, Bun, pnpm, Volta, nvm, and the Claude Code in the VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf extensions.
Check again finds a Claude Code installed after Vellum Plot started, says it looked, and when nothing is found says where it looked.
Program may be the folder the program is in.
From 0.3.0: fits stay connected to their data, with Update, Keep updated and Change parameters.
Coming from Patina Plot 0.1.x: it is now Vellum Plot (0.2.0), with the Assistant; your projects, settings and templates come along.
